purpose: Test whether speculative parallel NeuralRx and conventional execution can fit the Aerial testMAC 4.5 ms threshold after sequential wait-then-recover was 0/1000.
claim_boundary: This is neither a production d_MAC qualification nor a WCET bound. It omits MPS, external AI, IPC, controller RPC, real DU release timing, and real channels.
mechanism: Release two persistent same-process threads together; one runs NeuralRx and one runs conventional on independent receiver objects/streams; wait for both physical completions.
decision_rule: Report pair completion counts at 4.5 ms; do not promote any sample statistic to a bound.
